_comment: Shadow-Core Sentinel speaks MCP over SSE, not stdio.
which tells a client to SPAWN the exe and talk JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout.
But main.py runs mcp.run(transport='sse', host='127.0.0.1', port=7702), so
the process serves HTTP and never speaks stdio. A client using the old
config launches it, waits for stdio that never comes, and hangs.
SSE servers are NOT spawned by the client -- Sentinel must already be
running. It starts at logon via the 'Shadow Core MCP Servers' scheduled
Sentinel boots IDLE and watches nothing until a session calls
watch_project, so registering it costs nothing until it is used.
